items.originalTitle: Morgan Stanley sets Boeing stock price target
items.originalSummary: Morgan Stanley adjusted its Boeing (NYSE: BA ) stock price target by 10% on October 16, cutting it down from $250 to $225 while maintaining a positive “Buy” rating on the aviation company. Previously, Morgan Stanley doubled down on the $250 price target a day ahead of the Society of Professional Engineering Employees in Aerospace (SPEEA) labor vote on October 1, which the bank called “a potential tactical buying opportunity.” Analyst Kristine Liwag now lowers the forecast but notes that despite softer sentiment, demand is still intact across both commercial aerospace and defense. In addition, she notes that the team remains bullish on aerospace and defense heading into Q3 earnings. The call was accompanied by a modest uptic in BA share prices, which climbed back to $191 by press time, although they remain down nearly 6% on the monthly and 16% on the year-to-date (YTD) chart. The cut also arrives before Boeing’s third-quarter report scheduled for October 27, and it’s not an isolated incident, as RBC Capital also lowered its Boeing target from $265 to $235 just a day prior, which was a nearly identical reduction percentage-wise. According to RBC, Boeing faces lingering uncertainty, as the defense budget is likely to remain a noticeable headwind, no matter if third-quarter orders are looking strong. Similarly, Bernstein lowered its Boeing price target to $278 from $298 on October 12, saying that labor, certification, and production issues persist. While analyst comments suggest that there is no shortage of problems for Boeing to overcome, there are some potential growth catalysts. For example, the U.S. Air Force selected the company to develop the F-47, a next-generation fighter intended to succeed the F-22 Raptor. Among these developments, Barclays analyst Anthony Valentini initiated coverage on Boeing with a $300 BA price target last week, commenting that Boeing could be a potential beneficiary of emerging industrial shifts.

items.originalTitle: SMCI Maintained by Rosenblatt -- Price Target Stays at $51
items.originalSummary: Despite suffering a 21.92% plunge since October 7 and failing to gain the confidence of the wider Wall Street, Super Micro Computer (NASDAQ: SMCI ) stock is not entirely bereft of bulls. Indeed, in a note published on Thursday, October 15, Rosenblatt Securities’ Sajal Dogra judged the latest developments at Supermicro as positive and reiterated his previous ‘Buy’ rating and $51 price target. SMCI has been successful in presenting a ‘clean’ financial statement for the fiscal year 2026 (FY2026), and the decision to appoint Mark Long as Senior Vice President (SVP) and Chief Financial Officer (CFO) is praiseworthy, according to the analyst. Additionally, Dogra estimated that Supermicro shares remain undervalued, especially following the latest developments, thus meriting both the positive recommendation and the 45.34% forecasted upside relative to the latest close at $35.09. Notably, the expert from Rosenblatt first assigned the price target in late August, when SMCI stock was changing hands at $37.24. Meanwhile, Sajal Dogra is something of an outlier among the recent Wall Street Super Micro Computer equity ratings. Specifically, SMCI stock is, overall, considered a ‘Hold’ with two positive, three ‘Sell’, and eleven ‘Neutral’ recommendations, per the data Finbold retrieved from TipRanks on October 16. Additionally, Supermicro shares are, on average, expected to rally 12.24% to $39.38 in the coming 12 months; however, the number represents the result of all notes issued within the last three months. Finally, September and October have been dominated by ‘Hold’ and ‘Sell’ recommendations, with Rosenblatt being the only outlier between the two months. Susquehanna’s Mehdi Hosseini was by far the biggest bear to update his price target within the timeframe and, along with viewing SMCI stock as a ‘Sell’, he also forecasted a 57.25% collapse to $15 on September 12. Citi (NYSE: C ) analyst Asiya Merchant was the biggest bull – once Dogra is disregarded – with a ‘Hold’ recommendation and a $45 12-month Supermicro stock price target assigned on October 9.

items.originalTitle: Wall Street sets SMCI stock price target for next 12 months
items.originalSummary: Despite suffering a 21.92% plunge since October 7 and failing to gain the confidence of the wider Wall Street, Super Micro Computer (NASDAQ: SMCI ) stock is not entirely bereft of bulls. Indeed, in a note published on Thursday, October 15, Rosenblatt Securities’ Sajal Dogra judged the latest developments at Supermicro as positive and reiterated his previous ‘Buy’ rating and $51 price target. SMCI has been successful in presenting a ‘clean’ financial statement for the fiscal year 2026 (FY2026), and the decision to appoint Mark Long as Senior Vice President (SVP) and Chief Financial Officer (CFO) is praiseworthy, according to the analyst. Additionally, Dogra estimated that Supermicro shares remain undervalued, especially following the latest developments, thus meriting both the positive recommendation and the 45.34% forecasted upside relative to the latest close at $35.09. Notably, the expert from Rosenblatt first assigned the price target in late August, when SMCI stock was changing hands at $37.24. Meanwhile, Sajal Dogra is something of an outlier among the recent Wall Street Super Micro Computer equity ratings. Specifically, SMCI stock is, overall, considered a ‘Hold’ with two positive, three ‘Sell’, and eleven ‘Neutral’ recommendations, per the data Finbold retrieved from TipRanks on October 16. Additionally, Supermicro shares are, on average, expected to rally 12.24% to $39.38 in the coming 12 months; however, the number represents the result of all notes issued within the last three months. Finally, September and October have been dominated by ‘Hold’ and ‘Sell’ recommendations, with Rosenblatt being the only outlier between the two months. Susquehanna’s Mehdi Hosseini was by far the biggest bear to update his price target within the timeframe and, along with viewing SMCI stock as a ‘Sell’, he also forecasted a 57.25% collapse to $15 on September 12. Citi (NYSE: C ) analyst Asiya Merchant was the biggest bull – once Dogra is disregarded – with a ‘Hold’ recommendation and a $45 12-month Supermicro stock price target assigned on October 9.

items.originalTitle: RKLB Stock: Citizens Cuts Target To $90 As Neutron Delay Pushes Back Launch Revenue
items.originalSummary: Clear Street lowered its price target on the stock to $105 from $129 but kept a ‘Buy’ rating.The firm said the medium-lift rocket market opportunity is ‘only getting bigger.’KeyBanc lowered the price target to $100 from $135 but maintained an ‘Overweight’ rating.Rocket Lab (RKLB) shares drew investor attention on Thursday as Wall Street reacted to news that the debut of its much-anticipated Neutron rocket has been postponed to 2027. RKLB shares tumbled nearly 11% in pre-market trading and were on track to reach their lowest level since December 2025.Wall Street Remains Bullish Despite Neutron Launch DelayRoth Capital maintained a ‘Buy’ rating with a $110 price target, according to The Fly. The target is more than double the current trading price of roughly $53. The firm argued that Rocket Lab is prioritizing the quality and reliability of its rockets over “speed to pad.”Roth believes Rocket Lab’s investments in Neutron manufacturing and launch infrastructure could help it rapidly increase production once the rocket completes its first few flights successfully.Clear Street lowered the price target to $105 from $129 but kept a ‘Buy’ rating, with analyst Greg Pendy stating that while the delay pushes Rocket Lab’s growth and profitability back by three quarters, the medium-lift opportunity is “only getting bigger.”Meanwhile, KeyBanc lowered its price target to $100 from $135 while maintaining an ‘Overweight’ rating, according to The Fly. The revised target still implies around 47% upside from the stock’s current trading price.Why Rocket Lab Postponed Neutron TestOn Wednesday, Rocket Lab CEO Peter Beck said the company discovered manufacturing defects in the forward propellant dome of Neutron’s first stage, which holds the rocket’s fuel. Beck added that the company was unwilling to compromise on safety and reliability.“They don’t necessarily mean that the dome would fail on flight, but our practice is to proceed only when we believe the system has the appropriate margins,” Beck said.Rocket Lab has identified the fixes and expects the new dome to be completed before the first quarter (Q1) of 2027.Repeated Setbacks For NeutronFirst unveiled in 2021, Neutron has faced repeated setbacks over its launch timeline. The rocket was originally expected to launch in 2024, but was later pushed to 2025, then late 2026, and now 2027.Neutron is central to Rocket Lab’s ambitions and was seen as a competition for SpaceX's Falcon 9 in the reusable medium-lift rocket market. However, SpaceX is looking to wind down its Falcon 9 operations in favor of the much larger Starship rockets.Retail Calls RKLB Selloff A ‘Huge Overreaction’Retail sentiment on Stocktwits surrounding RKLB trended in the ‘bearish’ territory over the past 24 hours, amid a 565% jump in message volumes.One user called the selloff a “huge overreaction.”https://stocktwits.com/Greggy69/message/666566996Another user said, “everyone’s panicking about a delay we all kind of saw coming.”https://stocktwits.com/OceansApart/message/666562853RKLB shares are down more than 22% year-to-date, on par with rival Virgin Galactic Holdings’ (SPCE) 22% fall. items.title: 特斯拉 Roadster 可能不會帶來超出預期的收益，但這次盛大的發布確實實現了兩件事
items.originalTitle: Tesla Roadster probably won't drive an earnings beat, but the big unveil did achieve 2 things
items.originalSummary: The new Tesla ( TSLA ) Roadster probably won't be the deciding factor in the company beating on earnings when production possibly begins in 2028, but the high-profile reveal on Thursday night did achieve two things. "Two takeaways from tonight's Roadster event. 1. It was an engineering flex with no commercial value beyond embarrassing traditional car makers. 2. Elon can't wait to bring $TSLA and $SPCX together," veteran tech analyst Gene Munster said in an X post. Tesla unveiled its redesigned Roadster on Thursday night at SpaceX's ( SPCX ) rocket test site in McGregor, Texas. It came nearly nine years after Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk first showed his idea for the car in 2017.

investorBrief.event: 當新款特斯拉 (TSLA) Roadster 可能在 2028 年開始生產時，它可能不會成為該公司盈利增長的決定性因素，但周四晚上的高調披露確實實現了兩件事。 「今晚 Roadster 活動的兩個要點。1. Elon 迫不及待地將 $TSLA 和 $SPCX 結合在一起，」資深科技分析師 Gene Munster 在 X 帖子中表示。
investorBrief.why: 這會直接影響市場對未來營收、EPS 與估值的預期。投資上比已公布的單季數字更重要的是公司接下來的財測方向、毛利與需求能見度。

historyItems.originalTitle: Department of Commerce Announces Agreement with GlobalFoundries to Amend Its Existing CHIPS Program Award and Reallocate $955 Million to Accelerate Investments in Silicon Photonics, Silicon-Germanium, and Advanced Packaging
historyItems.originalSummary: Official websites use .gov A .gov website belongs to an official government organization in the United States. WASHINGTON, D.C. – The Department of Commerce’s CHIPS Program Office has agreed with GlobalFoundries to amend its existing award and reallocate up to $955 million in incentives under the CHIPS and Science Act. The amendment will increase the portion of an existing CHIPS Program award allocated to GlobalFoundries’ modernization and expansion of its semiconductor manufacturing facilities in Malta, NY and Burlington, VT. As part of the amendment, GlobalFoundries has agreed to expand its capital investment in these facilities to $5 billion. The total amount of the existing CHIPS Program award will not be increased. The investment will expand domestic manufacturing capacity for technologies increasingly critical to communications infrastructure and data centers, including silicon photonics, silicon-germanium and the first U.S.-based source of silicon interposers supporting advanced packaging technologies. “GlobalFoundries is expanding its investment to develop and manufacture critical semiconductor technologies enabling data center and high-performance compute infrastructure,” said Bill Frauenhofer, Executive Director for Semiconductor Innovation and Investment at the Department of Commerce. “The CHIPS Program award supports GlobalFoundries efforts to onshore and accelerate the development of these important semiconductor components." GlobalFoundries is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling technologies from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GlobalFoundries delivers differentiated, power efficient, and high-performance solutions for automotive, aerospace and defense, data center, smart mobile devices, internet of things and other high growth markets. historyItems.originalTitle: Chip-Machine Supplier ASML Boosts Guidance for Third Time on Surging AI Demand
historyItems.originalSummary: By Mauro Orru ASML Holding improved its annual forecasts for the third time this year and said it was looking at ways to boost production of its semiconductor-making machines even more as the race to build artificial-intelligence infrastructure fuels demand for advanced chips. The Dutch group is projecting annual sales between 44 billion euros and 45 billion euros, equivalent to a range of $49.27 billion to $50.39 billion, compared with prior guidance of 43 billion euros to 45 billion euros. Meanwhile, its gross margin--a closely watched metric of pricing power and profitability--should come in at roughly 56%, compared with a previous guidance range of 54% to 56%. The revisions show how much ASML's fortunes have come to benefit from the build-out of data centers that turned chips into a red-hot commodity. Surging semiconductor demand means that ASML's clients like Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Samsung Electronics and Intel will need more of its machines so they can produce enough chips. ASML shares in Amsterdam gained more than 2% in European morning trading, consolidating ASML's lead as Europe's most valuable listed company. Its stock is up more than 80% over the past 12 months on a wave of investor fervor around AI and expectations that chips and semiconductor-making tools will remain in high demand for years to come. "Our customers continue to increase their short- and medium-term equipment demand forecasts with us, driven primarily by their views on the size and duration of AI-related investments. In light of their demand visibility, some customers are expressing an interest in placing orders with us for 2029 and even 2030," ASML Chief Executive Christophe Fouquet said. AI demand pushed up the cost of certain types of chips as companies hoard semiconductors to power data centers, leading to a supply squeeze. Micron Technology Chief Executive Sanjay Mehrotra said last month that supplies of memory and storage chips would be much tighter in the coming years. In a bid to cash in on that tightness, ASML is seeking to increase production of its deep ultraviolet lithography tools as well as its more advanced extreme ultraviolet systems. In July, it had earmarked a 30% boost in 2027 and another 30% in 2028. However, Fouquet said it was becoming clear that wouldn't be enough to meet demand and that ASML was looking at ways to bolster capacity even more, especially for 2028 and beyond. Earlier this year, ASML executives alluded to the possibility of price increases, saying that a tight chip market gave ASML more negotiating power. Finance chief Roger Dassen said that while the company had now completed conversations with key customers, the effect of higher prices wouldn't show on 2026 figures. "It will start to become visible partly in the course of 2027. The full impact of that you will start to see in 2028 and beyond," he said. ASML posted sales of 11.66 billion euros for the third quarter, up from 7.52 billion euros a year earlier. historyItems.originalTitle: Is Applied Materials (AMAT) A Bargain Following Its EPIC Center Launch?
historyItems.originalSummary: Applied Materials (AMAT) just cut the ribbon on its EPIC Center in Sunnyvale, a US$5b semiconductor R&D hub that pulled the stock into focus after a modest premarket pullback. For investors, the near term has been choppy for Applied Materials, with the share price down 1.87% over the last session and 8.25% over the week. However, that pullback sits against a sharp year-to-date share price gain of 85.04% and a 1-year total shareholder return of 127.94%, which points to strong longer term momentum even as sentiment cools ahead of earnings and as the EPIC Center and recent AI-focused partnerships reset expectations around future opportunity and risk.

historyItems.originalTitle: SpaceX Dragon Lifts Off for Thursday Cargo Delivery
historyItems.originalSummary: NEW YORK, October 13. /TASS/. The US company SpaceX launched a Falcon 9 rocket carrying the Cargo Dragon spacecraft to the International Space Station (ISS) on Tuesday. The launch was streamed on the website of the US National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA). The spacecraft lifted off from the spaceport at Cape Canaveral, Florida, at 06:33 a.m. local time (1:33 p.m. Moscow time/10:33 a.m. GMT) on the 35th resupply mission to the orbital station. Cargo Dragon will transport more than 2.8 tons of cargo to the orbiting outpost, including equipment for scientific experiments studying the effects of microgravity on heart tissue, as well as a set of solar arrays for the ISS. The spacecraft is expected to dock automatically with the ISS on October 15. In mid-November, Cargo Dragon is scheduled to return to Earth carrying the results of scientific experiments and equipment for repair.

Elon Musk's rocket business said late last week it acquired a nationwide low-band spectrum portfolio . It positions Musk's satellite business, Starlink, to challenge legacy wireless giants across the US. Shares of AT&T ( T ), T-Mobile ( TMUS ), and Verizon ( VZ ) tanked on the news on Friday. Meanwhile, SpaceX is reportedly seeking to raise $40 billion in financing to purchase Nvidia chips. "The debate is whether a company this early in its public life should carry that much leverage," Yorkville Ives partner Dan Ives said. historyItems.originalTitle: Nokia to start dealing out GPUs in high-stakes AI-RAN gamble
historyItems.originalSummary: Some drivers are happy to run a car until the chassis has corroded and the engine coughs with every agonizing change of gear. Others less constrained by economic circumstances want a new vehicle every time the paint is nicked. Many big telcos currently seem to have more in common with the first group, determined to run their mobile networks until the basestations are shrouded in cobwebs. Any upgrades, including to 6G, should not have to require hardware replacement, they are telling vendors. Yet Nokia wants to sell them a completely new engine. The Finnish company has publicly teamed up with Nvidia to design radio access network (RAN) products built on the giant chipmaker's graphics processing units (GPUs). It has stopped developing new custom silicon with partner Marvell Technology, although it will continue to support its existing 4G and 5G range for years. Ultimately, however, customers will have to buy new hardware to enjoy new features. There is no guarantee the situation will be all that different for customers of Ericsson. Operators using its purpose-built 5G products today may need to invest in newer application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs) to support forthcoming 5G-Advanced and 6G software. But Nokia's GPU strategy is undoubtedly much riskier. While commonplace in data centers and certain gadgets, Nvidia's chips have never been used for RAN compute. If telcos balk at the idea, Nokia could be in trouble. "If you don't have a companion strategy that's based on classic ASICs, you really have created jeopardy, I think," said Marcus Weldon, a former Nokia chief technology officer who was also president of its Bell Labs research unit. Yet the rewards could be immense if Nokia can prove that GPUs have advantages over ASICs in the RAN. In recent months, it has argued that its GPU-led strategy will support a doubling in spectral efficiency, among other benefits, by 2028. In a RAN market that is not expected to grow in the next few years, such improvements could justify the initial hardware outlay and even translate into market share gains for Nokia, allowing it to recover 5G ground lost to Ericsson and Samsung. That could be a disaster for Nokia's rivals. Numerous operators are now giving Nokia's AI-RAN products a test drive before they become commercially available early next year. None has yet said anything in public about the initial experience, and many operators have previously voiced concern about using what is still perceived to be a very expensive and energy-hungry chip in the RAN. Overkill has been the word on some lips, as if putting a GPU in the RAN is like using a rocket launcher to kill a rat. But Nokia has been advertising a slimline GPU that could be slotted into an existing Airscale chassis originally designed to support Marvell Technology's silicon. It will have to function with the same power constraints and be available for the same price, according to executives. They have also promised it will support software upgrades and new AI algorithms for years – unlike any ASIC. historyItems.summary: 馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX 正在超越衛星互聯網，並大舉進軍美國無線市場。根據《華爾街日報》報道，該公司已同意從投資公司 Grain Management 購買蜂窩頻譜許可證，據稱這筆交易價值約 80 億美元，這是該公司迄今為止與 AT&T、Verizon 和 T-Mobile 等老牌行動營運商競爭的最大舉措。該協議涉及 800MHz 頻段的頻譜，該頻段用於透過蜂窩塔等地面基礎設施提供的行動服務，而不是衛星。如果收購獲得批准，SpaceX 可以將這些無線電波與其不斷發展的 Starlink 衛星網路結合起來，創造更全面的無線服務。
historyItems.originalTitle: Elon Musk's SpaceX just made a huge play to challenge the phone industry, and AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon stocks are getting crushed
historyItems.originalSummary: Elon Musk’s SpaceX is moving past satellite internet, and it’s making a big move into the US wireless market. The company has agreed to buy cellular spectrum licences from investment firm Grain Management in a deal reportedly worth about $8 billion, its biggest move yet to compete with established mobile carriers such as AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile, according to a WSJ report . The deal is for spectrum in the 800MHz band, which is for mobile services delivered via terrestrial infrastructure such as cell towers, not satellites. If the acquisition is approved, SpaceX could combine those airwaves with its growing Starlink satellite network to create a more comprehensive wireless service. SpaceX has already been rolling out Starlink in areas beyond the usual broadband. The company has been working with T-Mobile for over a year to offer basic wireless connectivity in remote areas. SpaceX is also launching newer Starlink satellites that are capable of carrying more data. The US Federal Communications Commission has approved SpaceX’s plan to launch up to 15,000 satellites dedicated to mobile services. But when AI's health advice goes wrong, doctors may never see the exchange behind it. Researchers from Binghamton University, Stanford, Texas A&M, and Indiana University published a paper in Nature Health examining what happens after a chatbot gives you bad health information. historyItems.summary: 馬斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX 正在超越衛星互聯網，並大舉進軍美國無線市場。根據《華爾街日報》報道，該公司已同意從投資公司 Grain Management 購買蜂窩頻譜許可證，據稱這筆交易價值約 80 億美元，這是該公司迄今為止與 AT&T、Verizon 和 T-Mobile 等老牌行動營運商競爭的最大舉措。該協議涉及 800MHz 頻段的頻譜，該頻段用於透過蜂窩塔等地面基礎設施提供的行動服務，而不是衛星。如果收購獲得批准，SpaceX 可以將這些無線電波與其不斷發展的 Starlink 衛星網路結合起來，創造更全面的無線服務。
historyItems.originalTitle: Elon Musk's SpaceX just made a huge play to challenge the phone industry and stocks like AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon are getting crushed
historyItems.originalSummary: Elon Musk’s SpaceX is moving past satellite internet, and it’s making a big move into the US wireless market. The company has agreed to buy cellular spectrum licences from investment firm Grain Management in a deal reportedly worth about $8 billion, its biggest move yet to compete with established mobile carriers such as AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile, according to a WSJ report . The deal is for spectrum in the 800MHz band, which is for mobile services delivered via terrestrial infrastructure such as cell towers, not satellites. If the acquisition is approved, SpaceX could combine those airwaves with its growing Starlink satellite network to create a more comprehensive wireless service. SpaceX has already been rolling out Starlink in areas beyond the usual broadband. The company has been working with T-Mobile for over a year to offer basic wireless connectivity in remote areas. SpaceX is also launching newer Starlink satellites that are capable of carrying more data. The US Federal Communications Commission has approved SpaceX’s plan to launch up to 15,000 satellites dedicated to mobile services. Leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, and other AI companies are reportedly preparing for a potential AI disaster that could turn the public against artificial intelligence. According to an Axios report, industry leaders are privately running through possible scenarios for what happens after a catastrophic AI incident. What kind of AI disaster are companies preparing for? AI is a useful tool for handling many tasks in private as well as professional settings, but medical advice, especially diagnosis, is one area where I generally draw the line. General-purpose chatbots tend to sound confident and convincing while giving medical advice, even when they are wrong, as studies have previously found. That being said, Google's new research points to a much more convincing use for AI in healthcare. Its Articulate Medical Intelligence Explorer chatbot, or AMIE for short, could help prepare both sides before the appointment even begins.

historyItems.title: CBRS 股價觸及一個月新高 — Cerebras 與 AMD 合作提供加速的 AI 效能
historyItems.summary: 在 Gimlet Labs 同意在新的分類推理雲端中使用其晶圓級晶片、針對付費客戶的超快代理和即時人工智慧工作負載後，Cerebras Systems (CBRS) 重新成為人們關注的焦點。在 Cerebras Systems 經歷了幾個月的動盪之後，新的 Gimlet Labs 交易達成，圍繞其 OpenAI 關係的相互矛盾的頭條新聞影響了市場情緒和短期交易。儘管奧特曼最近在公眾的支持下出現反彈，但該股的股價回報率在 30 天內仍下跌了 15.7%，年初至今下跌了 43.1%。這表明勢頭已經冷卻，隨著新合作夥伴關係的出現，投資者正在重新評估成長預期和感知的執行風險。
historyItems.originalTitle: CBRS Stock Hits One-Month High — Cerebras Partners With AMD To Deliver Accelerated AI Performance
historyItems.originalSummary: Cerebras Systems (CBRS) is back in focus after Gimlet Labs agreed to use its wafer-scale chips inside a new disaggregated inference cloud, targeting ultrafast agentic and real-time AI workloads for paying customers. The fresh Gimlet Labs deal lands after a volatile few months for Cerebras Systems, where conflicting headlines around its OpenAI relationship swung sentiment and short-term trading. Even with recent rebounds on Altman's public backing, the stock's share price return is still down 15.7% over 30 days and 43.1% year to date. This suggests momentum has cooled and investors are reassessing both growth expectations and perceived execution risk as new partnerships come into view.

historyItems.summary: 在公司和 TELUS 完成首次整合測試後，AST SpaceMobile (ASTS) 重新成為人們關注的焦點，該測試將 TELUS 的地面無線網路與 AST SpaceMobile 的衛星系統連接起來，在加拿大提供智慧型手機直接到衛星服務。 AST SpaceMobile 與 TELUS 的整合取得進展是在該公司股票經歷波動之後，該公司股價在過去一天下跌了 6.13%，在過去一個月下跌了 13.90%，導致今年迄今為止下跌了 31.80%。與上市初期相比，三年和五年的長期股東總回報仍然非常高，這表明近期的疲軟反映了風險預期的變化，而不是更廣泛的多年走勢的簡單逆轉。
historyItems.originalTitle: AST SpaceMobile (ASTS) Could Be 67% Undervalued On TELUS Integration Progress
historyItems.originalSummary: AST SpaceMobile (ASTS) moved back into focus after the company and TELUS completed their first integration test connecting TELUS' terrestrial wireless network with AST SpaceMobile's satellite based system for direct smartphone to satellite service in Canada. AST SpaceMobile's integration progress with TELUS comes after a volatile run for the stock, with the share price falling 6.13% over the past day and 13.90% over the past month, contributing to a 31.80% decline in the year to date. Long term total shareholder return over three and five years remains very large compared with the initial listing period, suggesting recent weakness reflects shifting risk expectations rather than a simple reversal of the broader multi year move.

historyItems.originalTitle: NASA Sets Coverage for SpaceX 35th Station Resupply Launch, Arrival
historyItems.originalSummary: A SpaceX Dragon cargo spacecraft departs from the International Space Station on June 16 after undocking from the Harmony module's forward port. Dragon, packed with completed science experiments and cargo for retrieval and analysis on Earth, parachuted to a splashdown off the coast of southern California the following day.NASA and SpaceX are targeting 6:33 a.m. EDT, Tuesday, Oct. 13, for the next launch to deliver science investigations, supplies, and equipment, including the final set of International Space Station Roll-Out Solar Arrays, to the space station. This is the 35th SpaceX commercial resupply services mission to the orbital complex for NASA.NASA also will host a media teleconference on Thursday, Oct. 8 that will preview the cargo resupply flight, as well as provide a post-splashdown update for the agency's SpaceX Crew-12 mission, which will have returned to Earth from the space station Thursday morning.Loaded with more than 6,300 pounds of supplies, a SpaceX Dragon spacecraft on a Falcon 9 rocket will lift off from Space Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida. Dragon will dock autonomously around 11 a.m. on Thursday, Oct. 15, to the space-facing port of the station's Harmony module.NASA's live launch and docking coverage will stream through a variety of platforms. Learn where to watch online:https://www.nasa.gov/liveIn addition to the solar arrays, the Dragon spacecraft will deliver hardware to manufacture artificial retinas in microgravity to help restore vision on Earth and 3D heart tissues models to advance large-scale drug testing on future missions. The spacecraft will carry materials to study how a new type of glass forms in microgravity and brain organoids that could reveal treatment targets for neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and multiple sclerosis.The Dragon spacecraft is scheduled to remain at the space station until mid-November when it will depart the orbiting laboratory and return to Earth with time-critical research and cargo, splashing down off the coast of California.NASA's mission coverage is as follows (all times Eastern and subject to change based on real-time operations):Thursday, Oct. 81:15 p.m.: International Space Station briefing for Crew-12 return, and SpaceX's 35th Commercial Resupply Services launch with the following participants:Bill Spetch, deputy manager of Commercial, Low Earth Orbit ProgramDr. Liz Warren, deputy chief scientist, NASA's International Space Station OfficeLee Echerd, senior mission manager, Customer Operations and Integration, SpaceXAndreas Mogensen, leader, Human Exploration Group, ESA (European Space Agency)To participate in the teleconference, media must contact the NASA Johnson Space Center newsroom for call details by 12 p.m., Oct. 8, at: jsccommu@mail.nasa.gov or 281-483-5111. To ask questions, media must dial in no later than 10 minutes before the start of the call. The agency's media credentialing policy is available online.Tuesday, Oct. 136:15 a.m.: Launch coverage begins6:33 a.m.: LaunchThursday, Oct. 159:15 a.m.: Arrival coverage begins11 a.m.: DockingNASA website laun

historyItems.title: 法官可能會命令 Nebius 停止獨立資料中心的建設
historyItems.summary: 動議聽證會定於 10 月 22 日舉行，涉及獨立城 Nebius 資料中心專案相關訴訟。獨立衛士聯盟 (Guardians United Against Reckless Development) 提起訴訟，要求停止在小藍谷建設 Nebius 超大規模人工智慧資料工廠。訴訟中指定的城市為密蘇裡州獨立市 ADC Holdings LLC（資料中心開發商）和 Independence Power Partners LP。小藍谷布萊路沿線的居民是希望停止他們家附近的施工。訴訟指控該市違反了分區和陽光法以及城市憲章，並且未能執行城市法律。居民要求法官暫停該項目。聽證會定於 10 月 9 日上午 9 點舉行。
historyItems.originalTitle: Judge could order Nebius to halt data center construction in Independence
historyItems.originalSummary: A motions hearing is set for Oct. 22 on a lawsuit related to the Nebius data center project in Independence.The Independence GUARD (Guardians United Against Reckless Development) Alliance filed the lawsuit to halt construction of the Nebius hyperscale AI data factory in the Little Blue Valley.Named in the lawsuit are the city of Independence, Missouri ADC Holdings LLC (data center developer) and Independence Power Partners LP.Residents along Bly Road in the Little Blue Valley are hoping to stop construction near their homes.The lawsuit alleges the city violated zoning and sunshine laws, as well as the city charter, and has failed to enforce city laws. Residents are asking a judge to pause the project.A hearing has been set for 9 a.m. on Oct. 22 on their motion for a temporary restraining order and the defendants' motion to dismiss.The Independence City Council approved billions of dollars in incentives for Dutch tech company Nebius to build and operate the 2.1-million-square-foot hyperscale AI data factory on 400 acres at the south end of Bly Road in March. Nebius broke ground on the first phase of the project in April.Nebius — which is party to the lawsuit through a subsidiary, Missouri ADC Holdings — provided us a statement about the lawsuit when it was filed earlier this year in Jackson County Circuit Court.“We are reviewing the claims and cannot comment on the case specifics,” Nebius Vice President of Public Affairs John Sutter said in a statement. “Nebius remains committed to complying with all applicable laws and regulations, and being a responsible partner for the community as our historic investment in Independence takes shape.”—

historyItems.title: Teradyne 增強了 Titan HP 的 AI 晶片可靠性測試能力
historyItems.summary: Teradyne, Inc. 宣布推出一款可投入生產的系統，可在其 Titan? 上提供增強的預燒功能？惠普平台。傳統的老化會將設備在受控空氣溫度下的專用烘箱中保存數小時，然後再進行功能測試。相反，Teradyne Titan HP 在運行實際設備工作負載時將每個設備保持在其目標結溫，從而優化可靠性應力功能，並在每個設備級別啟用熱控制。
historyItems.originalTitle: Teradyne enhances Titan HP for AI chip reliability tests
historyItems.originalSummary: Teradyne, Inc. announced a production-ready system that delivers enhanced burn-in capabilities on its Titan? HP platform. Traditional burn-in holds devices in banks of dedicated ovens at a controlled air temperature for hours before they move on to functional test.Teradyne Titan HP instead holds each device at its target junction temperature while running a realistic device workload, so reliability stress functions are optimized and thermal controls are enabled at the per-device level. Titan HP can be used for system level test or reliability testing, optimizing capital cost investments. For reliability testing, every device carries its full stress-and-test history on a single record.Per-site thermal control, tuned to each device's thermal and force zones, and paired with high per-device kilowatt power delivery, lets Titan HP sustain reliability-stress conditions on parts whose power draw and heat dissipation strain a conventional oven flow. The platform's asynchronous slot architecture loads and tests each slot independently, so a long stress run on one device does not idle the rest of the system, and individual sites can be serviced while the system continues to operate. Test programs run on the Teradyne Atlas software platform, which lets engineers import existing programs or build new ones and port them to other Teradyne system level test systems. Burn-in has long been standard for automotive and other high-reliability silicon.AI accelerators and cloud infrastructure devices are now entering the same category, driven by the high cost of a single failed accelerator in a deployed rack. Enhanced burn-in extends Teradyne?s test portfolio, which spans the AI device supply chain from wafer to data center.

historyItems.originalTitle: Is Planet Labs PBC (PL) Cheap Following Its 20 Satellite Launches?
historyItems.originalSummary: Planet Labs PBC (PL) just put 20 more satellites into orbit, including a prototype for Google's Project Suncatcher and the hyperspectral Tanager-2. This development raises fresh questions about how this build-out might affect the stock. Recent product milestones have arrived against a tougher tape for Planet Labs PBC. The 1-day share price return declined 0.8% to US$17.36 and the 90-day share price return fell 39.4%, even though the 1-year total shareholder return is 13.9% and the 3-year total shareholder return is roughly 7x. This suggests the market is reassessing near term risk even as longer term holders remain ahead.

historyItems.originalTitle: Marvell raises 2028 revenue forecast on strong AI data center demand
historyItems.originalSummary: Marvell raised its 2028 revenue forecast to about $20 billion on Tuesday, citing strong demand for its chips used in data centers.Shares of the company rose nearly 9% in early trading. The stock has more than tripled in value so far this year.Marvell had forecast $18 billion in revenue in August. Analysts were expecting revenue of $18.2 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG.

historyItems.summary: 資料中心連接和客製化人工智慧晶片製造商 Marvell Technology（納斯達克股票代碼：MRVL）收在 287.01 美元，上漲 5.81%。投資者對投資者日指引做出了反應，該指引提高了近期和長期收入目標，他們正在關注下一步定制人工智慧的成長。交易量達到 5,010 萬股，比三個月平均 2,260 萬股高出約 122%。 Marvell Technology 於 2000 年首次公開募股，自上市以來已成長 1,927%。
historyItems.originalTitle: Marvell stock surges after company raises 2028 revenue outlook to $20 billion
historyItems.originalSummary: Marvell Technology (NASDAQ:MRVL), a data-center connectivity and custom AI chipmaker, closed at $287.01, up 5.81%. Investors were reacting to Investor Day guidance that lifted near- and long-term revenue targets, and they are watching custom AI growth next. Trading volume reached 50.1 million shares, coming in about 122% above its three-month average of 22.6 million shares. Marvell Technology IPO'd in 2000 and has grown 1,927% since going public.

historyItems.originalTitle: AMD plans to substantially increase supply in 2027, CEO says
historyItems.originalSummary: AMD plans to increase its chip supply in 2027 as the company works to keep pace with demand for artificial intelligence hardware, chair and CEO Lisa Su said Tuesday, according to Reuters . historyItems.originalTitle: KLA (KLAC) Stock Looks Rich As Revenue Guidance Rises
historyItems.originalSummary: In recent days, KLA Corporation has attracted renewed attention as analysts highlighted its essential process-control role in easing the chip shortage and supporting AI-focused semiconductor manufacturing, while also pointing to ongoing risks from U.S. export restrictions and cyclical wafer equipment spending. At the same time, upward revisions to earnings estimates and commentary about KLA's differentiated tools for advanced packaging and complex chip designs have reinforced the company's importance to AI infrastructure build-outs, even as investors weigh exposure to tariffs, component costs, and concentrated customer demand. We'll now examine how this stronger analyst sentiment around KLA's critical AI-related process-control demand reshapes and reinforces its existing investment narrative.

historyItems.summary: Crew-12 的四名成員已在太空生活了近八個月，他們最早將於週三離開國際太空站。美國太空總署太空人傑西卡·梅爾和傑克·海瑟薇、歐洲太空總署太空人索菲·阿德爾諾特和俄羅斯太空總署太空人安德烈·費德亞耶夫四人於 2 月 13 日乘坐 SpaceX 載人龍自由號從卡納維拉爾角太空部隊站發射升空。不過，隨著 Crew-13 上週抵達國際太空站，他們已經向新船員展示了他們的軌道家園，並準備返回地球。
historyItems.originalTitle: NASA to Stream SpaceX Crew-12 Return, Splashdown Live
historyItems.originalSummary: With nearly eight months in space under their belt, the four members of Crew-12 are set to depart the International Space Station as early as Wednesday. The quartet of NASA astronauts Jessica Meir and Jack Hathaway, European Space Agency astronaut Sophie Adenot and Roscosmos cosmonaut Andrey Fedyaev launched from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station back on Feb. 13 riding up in the SpaceX Crew Dragon Freedom. With the arrival of Crew-13 to the station last week, though, they have shown the new crew around their orbiting home and are ready to make their way back to Earth.

historyItems.originalTitle: Homeowners seek subpoena for mayor’s wife’s realty company in Nebius data center suit
historyItems.originalSummary: Birmingham Mayor Randall Woodfin is pushing back after his wife and her real-estate company were named in a discovery dispute tied to a lawsuit over a proposed Birmingham data center. In a statement posted to Facebook Wednesday, Woodfin said his wife, Kendra Woodfin, and her company, Iron City Premier Realty, had no involvement in the purchase or sale of the property where the Nebius data center is planned. “Here we go again,” Woodfin said. “This is a bald-faced lie. “My wife and her business had nothing to do with this property. She had no part in the purchase. No part in the sale. No connection to this litigation. There isn't a shred of evidence that says otherwise, because there's nothing to find. She wasn't involved. Period.” The comments follow an Oct. 6 filing in Jefferson County Circuit Court in which Iron City objected to a proposed subpoena from homeowners challenging the data-center project. Iron City said it “had no involvement” in the acquisition, purchase, sale, conveyance, financing, brokerage, development, zoning, permitting or closing of the property identified in the subpoena. The company also argued the subpoena is overly broad and that the plaintiffs have not established a factual basis connecting Iron City to the transaction. The court has not ruled on the objections. Woodfin also emphasized that his wife is a private citizen and has no role in Birmingham's zoning or permitting decisions. “She is a business owner. She is the mother of our children. She is a private citizen. She has never held office in this city. She doesn't vote on zoning. She doesn't sign permits. She doesn't sit on the Zoning Board of Adjustment or the City Council,” he said. Woodfin accused the attorneys behind the filing of intentionally putting his wife's business name into the case because of her relationship to him. “They wanted a headline,” he said. “Everybody knows how politically charged and unpopular data centers are. That's the play. You put a name in a court filing. Reporters read court filings. The story writes itself: ‘Mayor's wife named in data center lawsuit.’” Woodfin said he plans to pursue legal options to protect his wife's reputation. “We are going to be as aggressive as possible, exploring every legal recourse available to protect my wife's good name and the professional reputation of her business. This won't be the last you hear about it.” The mayor said he is accustomed to criticism but does not want his wife drawn into political disputes. “Come at me all day. I've been taking hits for nine years, and I'll take plenty more. That's the job I signed up for. My wife didn't. And I won't let her become collateral damage in a political hit designed to get at me.” The underlying lawsuit was filed by homeowners Robert B. Sansome and Gail Sansome against Hoar Construction LLC, Lakeshore Data Center LLC, Nebius Inc. and the City of Birmingham. The case remains in discovery, with a non-jury trial scheduled for March 8, 2027. A judge is scheduled to hear arguments Wednesday on objections involving subpoenas. The latest filings do not establish that Kendra Woodfin or Iron City Premier Realty participated in the property transactions at issue.

historyItems.originalTitle: Kratos Reports More Than $100M in Contracts for Space Intelligence Data
historyItems.originalSummary: SAN DIEGO, Oct. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Kratos Defense & Security Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: KTOS), a technology company in defense, national security, and global markets, today announced multiple contract awards totaling over $100 million to develop prototype mission applications and cyber capabilities providing space intelligence data in support of joint operations across the space and cyberspace domains. Work under the contracts will provide warfighters with capabilities to collect and process complex radio frequency (RF) signals, develop intelligence on the operational environment and support the joint targeting cycle – the process used to identify, prioritize and target assets. The prototype systems will support electronic warfare and offensive cyber operations, including capabilities for access and battle damage assessment. The work leverages the KnownSpace ® Network, Kratos’ global RF collection infrastructure consisting of more than 190 strategically placed sensors around the world, along with RF data and capabilities provided by KnownSpace Recon+™, Kratos’ field-portable space domain awareness (SDA) terminals. In addition, the contracts will leverage Kratos’ software products, analytics and expertise in RF, signal processing, cybersecurity and software development, establishing a proven technology base that can be adapted and integrated to meet emerging space and cyber mission requirements. “Kratos brings decades of space experience together with proven commercial technology and agile engineering to solve some of today’s most complex mission challenges,” said Greg Caicedo, Senior Vice President at Kratos . “Our systems, software and hardware support missions across SDA, command & control, satellite operations and cybersecurity. By building on proven technology and rapidly adapting it to emerging mission needs, we can deliver new capabilities faster and keep pace as the space environment changes.” The Kratos KnownSpace family of SDA products and services which support these awards provide deep insights for global, sovereign, and tactical operations. Built on more than 30 years of satellite monitoring and RF expertise, the KnownSpace family combines global RF sensing, software, managed operations and deployable systems to detect, characterize and understand satellite and terrestrial activity. Solutions include enterprise software applications, portable form factors that can be deployed anywhere and persistent global RF signal monitoring and geolocation through its KnownSpace Network of over 20 locations and 190 sensors worldwide—the largest commercially owned, commercially operated (COCO) RF sensor network.

historyItems.originalTitle: Teradyne Partners with Bright Machines to Put Robots, Test Tech in AI Infrastructure Microfactories
historyItems.originalSummary: NORTH READING, Mass. and SAN FRANCISCO, Oct. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Teradyne, Inc. (NASDAQ: TER), a leading provider of automated test equipment and advanced robotics systems, and Bright Machines, Inc., a next-generation manufacturer bringing AI and data center infrastructure production to the edge, today announced a strategic investment by Teradyne in Bright Machines. The investment accompanies a strategic collaboration focused on integrating Teradyne robotics and test technologies with Bright Machines’ software-defined manufacturing platform and advancing AI infrastructure manufacturing. AI infrastructure is driving one of the largest electronics manufacturing buildouts in recent history. As hyperscalers, AI laboratories, silicon providers, and OEMs invest in next-generation compute, manufacturing has become a determinant of deployment speed, quality, and economic value, and manufacturers place a premium on lines that can be reconfigured in software as product designs refresh. Teradyne works with manufacturers across that ecosystem, including EMS and ODM providers, OEMs, and hyperscalers, supplying the robotics and test technologies that make high-mix, high-value electronics production possible. Bright Machines brings a unique software-defined manufacturing platform spanning design, robotics, automation, inspection, material movement, production intelligence, and operations, with a history of more than 130 microfactory deployments across 10+ countries and, today, active AI infrastructure production in the United States. "Physical AI is changing what is possible on the factory floor, and Teradyne and Bright Machines are partnering to accelerate this evolution," said Shantnu Sharma, chief development officer, Teradyne. "The combination of Bright Machines depth in software-defined manufacturing, and Teradyne’s decades of experience in robotics and test gives companies building AI infrastructure a faster path from design into production, with data behind every unit they build."

historyItems.originalTitle: Teradyne Makes Strategic Investment in Bright Machines to Advance AI Infrastructure Manufacturing
historyItems.originalSummary: NORTH READING, Mass. and SAN FRANCISCO, Oct. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Teradyne, Inc. (NASDAQ: TER), a leading provider of automated test equipment and advanced robotics systems, and Bright Machines, Inc., a next-generation manufacturer bringing AI and data center infrastructure production to the edge, today announced a strategic investment by Teradyne in Bright Machines. The investment accompanies a strategic collaboration focused on integrating Teradyne robotics and test technologies with Bright Machines’ software-defined manufacturing platform and advancing AI infrastructure manufacturing. AI infrastructure is driving one of the largest electronics manufacturing buildouts in recent history. As hyperscalers, AI laboratories, silicon providers, and OEMs invest in next-generation compute, manufacturing has become a determinant of deployment speed, quality, and economic value, and manufacturers place a premium on lines that can be reconfigured in software as product designs refresh. Teradyne works with manufacturers across that ecosystem, including EMS and ODM providers, OEMs, and hyperscalers, supplying the robotics and test technologies that make high-mix, high-value electronics production possible. Bright Machines brings a unique software-defined manufacturing platform spanning design, robotics, automation, inspection, material movement, production intelligence, and operations, with a history of more than 130 microfactory deployments across 10+ countries and, today, active AI infrastructure production in the United States. "Physical AI is changing what is possible on the factory floor, and Teradyne and Bright Machines are partnering to accelerate this evolution," said Shantnu Sharma, chief development officer, Teradyne. "The combination of Bright Machines depth in software-defined manufacturing, and Teradyne’s decades of experience in robotics and test gives companies building AI infrastructure a faster path from design into production, with data behind every unit they build."

historyItems.originalSummary: AXT, Inc. (NasdaqGS: AXTI), a leading manufacturer of compound semiconductor substrates, will announce its financial results for the third quarter 2026 in a press release immediately following the close of market on October 29, 2026.The company will also host a conference call to discuss these results on October 29, 2026 at 1:30 p.m. PT. The conference call can be accessed at (833) 461-5787 (passcode 457551713). The call will also be simulcast at www.axt.com. The webcast will be available at http://www.axt.com until October 29, 2027. Additional investor information can be accessed at http://www.axt.com.About AXT, Inc.AXT is a material science company that develops and manufactures high-performance compound and single element semiconductor substrate wafers comprising indium phosphide (InP), gallium arsenide (GaAs) and germanium (Ge). The company’s substrate wafers are used when a typical silicon substrate wafer cannot meet the performance requirements of a semiconductor or optoelectronic device. End markets include AI/data center connectivity, 5G infrastructure, passive optical networks, LED lighting, lasers, sensors, power amplifiers for wireless devices and satellite solar cells. AXT’s worldwide headquarters are in Fremont, California where the company maintains sales, administration and customer service functions. AXT has its Asia headquarters in Beijing, China and manufacturing facilities in three separate locations in China. In addition, as part of its supply chain strategy, the company has partial ownership in over ten companies in China producing raw materials for its manufacturing process. historyItems.originalTitle: Latest Injury Update on Texans WR Tank Dell Isn't Too Promising
historyItems.originalSummary: The wait for Houston Texans wide receiver Tank Dell continues. KPRC 2’s Aaron Wilson noted that it is currently “not the plan” to have Dell back following Week 4 against the Dallas Cowboys, the earliest he can return. Moreover, Wilson said Dell will not return “unless he can run at speed they want him to run at.” None of that is new from Wilson or the Texans. However, the insider did provide a rather dour outlook for Dell. “It is a serious injury, and he is not there yet, and they also don’t have a home for him at this point with the other receivers they have up. They’ve given us no timeline,” Wilson said during a live stream on October 2. “I’ve checked on this. It’s not imminent. I can tell you that. If it happens–if it happens–it’s later in the season.” Dell has not played since Week 16 of the 2024 season. https://twitter.com/Clay_HTXSports/status/2106128199990280418 He was a top target for Texans quarterback and draft classmate C.J. Stroud. However, the Texans have since added Kayshon Boutte (who replaces injured 2025 second-round pick Jayden Higgins in the lineup) and Jaylin Noel since Dell last played. They still have Nico Collins at the top of the pecking order. Bigger-bodied targets Xavier Hutchinson and Jared Wayne have also earned more opportunities in Dell’s absence. That is not to say any of them would play ahead of a fully healthy Dell. Part of his return process, though, will certainly include rebuilding the on-field chemistry and timing with Stroud and the offense. That is in addition to proving that he is still a superior option to some of his teammates in the passing game. Dell is also in the final year of his rookie contract. That only adds to the uncertainty around his future with the Texans. The former Houston Cougars star was supposed to play in the preseason, per DeMeco Ryans. “We’ve taken our time to kind of ramp them up slowly. So, our first week he was just on the side still, working, just some individual stuff with his position coach at the practice. And now, this past week, he got into routes on air. He got into group install. And yesterday, for the first time, he was able to get in the team drills,” Ryans said on SiriusXM NFL Radio in August. “We’ll keep giving him a little bit more every day. Planning for him to, hopefully, get out there preseason–in one of these preseason games coming up–and then be ready to go for the season.” https://twitter.com/JacobBarzilla/status/2078958050828755097 At the time, Ryans noted how proud he was of Dell’s comeback journey. For the situation to go from that sort of optimism to the more dour tones it has taken on now is disappointing. It is even more so given the kind of boost a healthy Dell could provide the 0-3 Texans. Instead, they will continue to bide their time without him. Meanwhile, he must continue working to prove he can be the same player he was for the Texans before his latest devastating injury two years ago.

historyItems.originalTitle: Is Sovereign AI Partnership Altering The Investment Case For Cisco (CSCO)?
historyItems.originalSummary: In late September 2026, Bell Canada and Cisco announced a memorandum of understanding to build a sovereign AI infrastructure platform in Canada, combining Bell's domestic data centres and networks with Cisco's AI, security, observability, and Sovereign Critical Infrastructure technologies for customers with strict data residency and control needs. This move highlights how Cisco is trying to embed its AI-focused networking, security, and infrastructure stack into regulated markets where trust, control, and resilience are central requirements. We'll now examine how this Canadian sovereign AI collaboration, especially its focus on regulated-sector workloads, reshapes Cisco's existing investment narrative.
